name: @simdad/tass-cli
description: TASS's command line for humans and AI: score documents against the bundled open lexicons (or an imported LIWC-format .dic), analyze raw text to JSON, list the bundle with citations, run KWIC concordance, and serve the whole engine over MCP (stdio) for AI agents. Thin, dependency-free shell over @simdad/tass-core; same determinism guarantee (same input => byte-identical output).

scripts.test: node --test test/cli.test.cjs test/determinism.test.cjs test/m3-throughput.test.cjs test/mcp.test.cjs test/gui.test.cjs test/validation-cli.test.cjs
